sections.name: Why Your Stomach Growls
lines: That noise isn't your stomach complaining. Well, not exactly.
Your stomach and intestines are tubes of muscle that squeeze in waves, to push food along.
Even when they're empty, they keep squeezing, every couple of hours, to sweep out leftovers.
With no food to muffle it, the gas and liquid inside gurgle and echo, loudly.
Doctors even have a name for it. Borborygmi.
And a hunger hormone called ghrelin makes those waves even stronger.
So yes, it pretty much means, feed me.
